prompts.light: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: full-screen portrait BACKGROUND IMAGE for the connect-to-host screen in Opencode Client, a native iOS coding app. Supplied brand icon is visual reference only. Match its restrained blocky square-corner geometry and warm monochrome palette. Beautiful minimal architectural composition: very faint oversized cropped rectangular frames at outer corners, a sparse delicate orthogonal grid, a single subtle stepped connection path with small square endpoint nodes confined to the lower quarter and side margins. Sophisticated flat graphic design, soft tonal depth, crisp geometry, lots of breathing room. Central 70 percent horizontally and central 65 percent vertically must stay essentially empty and very low contrast for a native sign-in form overlaid later. Decorative elements are peripheral, never a central logo or central object. No text, no letters, no UI, no form, no buttons, no device mockups, no rounded shapes, no teal or bright colors, no watermark. Edge-to-edge opaque portrait image, target 1024x1536. LIGHT APPEARANCE: warm porcelain/off-white #F7F5F2 background, extremely subtle stone gray linework, gentle paper-like refinement without visible grain.
